scope: Immutable nine-copy source/design review and tiny pure Python condition witnesses only; offline/native tests not run or accepted by reviewer.
positive_source_findings: New compiler summarize_abilities/compile_interability_regions composes typed dispatch edges from static AST events, not a renamed runtime continuation interpreter. Accepted entry branch returns before old interpreter path.
Finite A→B→C uses unrolled CTE composition; one-rule homogeneous self-edge uses recursive SQL. Cycles among multiple ability rules are excluded.

Typed guard SQL uses jsonb_typeof plus text comparison without casting. Wrong/missing/null values yield invalid markers; full ordered rows are validated before publish_paths. Disabled valid-false guard does not publish its unexecuted outgoing path.

Fanout/closure/order/cycle/truncation are checked before atomic publication; enabled terminal empty paths are staged. Actor/ACL context and per-phase exact source/target type/module checks are present. Unchanged native prefix/full-key publication primitives are reused.

_trace_node_effects marks any applicable node entry callback unknown; regions322 consumes that unknown flag, so no additional writes/may_cancel handling is needed for those already rejected entries. The specific exit applicability gap is I3.

findings.issue: Any unsafe current field rejects the region, including normal internal __jac__ cached NodeAnchor metadata.
findings.witness: known_node_fields iterates vars; ordinary NodeArchetype.__jac__ is cached_property. Populated current node has __jac__::unsafe, so the all-fields test declines even RegionTraverse.
findings.bounded_fix: Validate only touched ordinary scalar fields and relevant actual cached values; do not interpret internal metadata as user scalar. Preserve actual nonprimitive/subclass rejection on touched fields.

findings.issue: Descriptor validation includes reads but omits write-only output destinations.
findings.witness: self.sink=1 has writes self.sink and no self.sink read. sink property setter can have effects despite standard Archetype.__setattr__ delegating object.__setattr__. The current descriptor scan never sees sink.
findings.bounded_fix: Include output write destinations in descriptor/effect validation; conservative descriptor fallback is sufficient.

findings.issue: Typed node exit applicability uses the node source class as trigger subject; node exit trigger refers to walker class.
findings.witness: Node exit callback triggered by RegionGuard: issubclass(RegionB,RegionGuard) is false although issubclass(type(wlk),RegionGuard) is true. Applicable unknown node exits bypass the declared conservative boundary.
findings.bounded_fix: Separate walker-exit (source-node trigger) from node-exit (walker trigger) checks; unknown matching effects decline.

findings.issue: Fast payload dispatch ignores remaining submission budget.
findings.witness: max_length4, prior submitted3, region payload3 fresh IDs: branch sends all3 and total becomes6; legacy path518 clips to remaining1.
findings.bounded_fix: Cap dispatch candidates to remaining=max_length-len(submitted), including previous scopes/regions. SQL path certification budget and payload submission budget may be distinct but must be explicit.

findings.issue: Output scalar arithmetic is marked output-only without operator-specific typed/nonraising validation; None/list/str state is allowed by the same generic read check.
findings.witness: RegionReduction with total=None passes allowed state types yet total+=value raises TypeError. Valid declared ints do not make division safe: total/=here.value with value0 is statically accepted by the underlying Div support and raises before visit.
findings.bounded_fix: First kernel may restrict to exact safe scalar/report/addition forms with actual-type checks, or an enforced explicit supported-data/operator contract. Unknown/unsafe arithmetic should fall back. No arbitrary exception solver is requested.

limits: No claim of actual native mismatch or SQL activation from these pure witnesses; immutable native evidence remains pending.
Broad aliases, FIFO theorem framework, cost/prepared reuse and old-source re-audits are outside this review.
next_scope: Inspect only immutable repair delta and focused accepted native evidence; no new loop absent concrete issue.
